n08.rewritten_query: Self-RAG CRAG retrieval necessity decision adaptive retrieval when retrieval unnecessary or incorrect
n08.hypothetical_document: Self-RAG and CRAG use internal signals to decide if retrieval or extra knowledge is needed, triggering retrieval only when required. If retrieval is judged unnecessary or incorrect, the systems bypass or discard it, relying on their internal knowledge or alternative generation paths instead.
